title: The right inversion, four bugs, and an honest stop
the_question_asked: 'you sure this is the smartest approach?'
the_answer: no. The approach was wrong: I was writing REGEXES TO PARSE ENGLISH (verb lists, capitalisation rules, date grammar). That is 1990s NLP, and every failure was a failure of that idea, not of its implementation.

the_inversion.principle: the goal is UNDERSPECIFIED LANGUAGE; the page is FULLY SPECIFIED DATA. Do not parse the query -- search the index.
the_inversion.mechanism: candidates = every string the page actually renders; target = the longest candidate the goal mentions; refusal on ties
the_inversion.why_it_is_better: no verb list, no capitalisation rule, no date grammar, no demonstration, and every answer is a string the page renders, so it is clickable and checkable by construction

four_bugs_found_and_fixed_in_one_round.bug: the goal is rendered onto the page
four_bugs_found_and_fixed_in_one_round.symptom: 'Click on the numbers in ascending order.' matched as its own target
four_bugs_found_and_fixed_in_one_round.fix: exclude page strings that CONTAIN and are longer than the goal

four_bugs_found_and_fixed_in_one_round.bug: the goal-exclusion filter removed the target
four_bugs_found_and_fixed_in_one_round.symptom: 'Tab #1' on the page AND in the goal was deleted -> NOT_MENTIONED on a trivially solvable task
four_bugs_found_and_fixed_in_one_round.fix: exclude only the rendered goal, never a page string that appears in it

four_bugs_found_and_fixed_in_one_round.symptom: target='Submit' on 4 of 6 tasks, because 'Submit' appears in almost every goal
four_bugs_found_and_fixed_in_one_round.fix: demote boilerplate below EVERY non-boilerplate match

measured_status.what_is_real: click-tab grounds correctly and wins (0.909); the inversion finds real targets
measured_status.what_is_not: the remaining failures are candidate-collection bugs, not failures of the inversion

why_i_am_stopping_here_rather_than_shipp: eight changes across two rounds on an uncommitted measurement is how a harness becomes a tuning set. The next measurement must be on goals and pages the extractor was NOT designed against (r69), and the candidate collector must be fixed first.
the_honest_reading: the inversion is the right idea and is not yet a working module. Saying 'the inversion works, 2/6' would repeat the r87 error of reporting a number from a broken instrument.
